entities.name: Bacterial uL16 Q110B4
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Trichodesmium erythraeum large ribosomal subunit protein uL16 (137 aa).
Annotated to bind 23S rRNA and contact A-site and possibly P-site tRNAs; associated with ribosomal structure and translation.
Sequence-derived estimates: 15,729.268 Da; pI 11.36; charge at pH 7 +16.52; GRAVY -0.5255.
